pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Avoid Inventing Past Promotional Prices
lesson.when: Explaining why a promotional code has expired or why channel prices differ
lesson.do: State only verified details present in tool outputs, such as promo expiration, without asserting specific past price amounts not supported by evidence
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about unverified past pricing instead of claiming specific prior figures
triggers: chênh lệch giá giữa các kênh
